about.title: About Pandora® ChatBot
about.description: Modular multi-provider AI chat client (Claude, Gemini, Ollama) with role system, multilingualism and local, encrypted configuration.
help.title: Help
help.body:
1. Select an AI provider on the left.
2. Select one or more roles from the list (multiple selection).
3. Store your API key in the provider's settings.
4. Write your message below and press send.
chat_appearance.title: Chat representation
chat_appearance.preview: This is what your text will look like in the chat.
help.setup.intro: Pandora® ChatBot is ready to go in four quick steps:
help.setup.step1: 1. Select an AI provider (Claude, Gemini or Ollama) in the sidebar on the left.
help.setup.step2: 2. Open Settings → <Anbieter> and enter your API key (for Ollama: the server address). You can find the exact steps for each provider in the 'API Keys' tab.
help.setup.step3: 3. Select one or more roles on the left (multiple selection) - they will be combined into your system prompt.
help.setup.step4: 4. Write your message below and press send. Complete!
help.api_keys.intro: This is how you get a separate API key for each provider:
help.api_keys.claude.title: Claude (Anthropic)
help.api_keys.claude.steps:
1. Go to console.anthropic.com and log in (or register).
2. Open 'API Keys' on the left.
3. Click on 'Create Key' and copy the key shown.
4. Paste it here in the Claude settings - it will only be saved locally in claude.env.
help.api_keys.gemini.title: Gemini (Google AI)
help.api_keys.gemini.steps:
1. Go to aistudio.google.com.
2. Sign in with your Google account.
3. Click on 'Get API key' → 'Create API key' at the top.
4. Paste it here in the Gemini settings - it will only be saved locally in gemini.env.
help.api_keys.ollama.title: Ollama (local)
help.api_keys.ollama.steps:
1. Install Ollama from ollama.com for your operating system.
2. Ollama usually starts its server automatically ('ollama serve').
3. Download a model, e.g. E.g. with 'ollama pull llama3.1'.
4. Enter the server address (default: http://localhost:11434) in the Ollama settings - no API key required.
